license.name: Public domain (flag images, as stated by Flagpedia)
license.summary: Flagpedia states its flag images may be used freely for commercial and non-commercial purposes. The provider says its flags are based on Wikimedia Commons vector files. This statement applies to the images, not the provider website text, layout or code.

usage: Local flag images for the country/region selector; no runtime CDN request is required.
imagePolicy: Use original-width w80 PNG; no resize, crop, re-encoding or invented flags. Display with object-fit: contain to retain nonstandard proportions.
codeNotes: All 250 region metadata codes match the same lowercase FlagCDN code, including XK; no substitutions were necessary.
The countries/regions list and flag choices follow their respective source datasets.
